evals.name: List-view-only extraction (fast mode)
evals.prompt: Extract ads from this LinkedIn Ad Library URL: https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise. Use list-view-only mode (no detail pages) and get the first page of ads.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file containing extracted ad data including advertiser names, ad types, headlines, descriptions, and detail URLs for ads visible on the first page. Should complete in 5-10 seconds without opening any detail page tabs.

evals.name: Detail page extraction (full mode)
evals.prompt: Extract ads from this LinkedIn Ad Library URL: https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise. Include detail page data (destination URLs, full impressions, detailed targeting). Limit to 1 page.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with complete ad data including destination URLs, paid_for_by, ad_duration, total_impressions, and full targeting_info for each ad.

evals.name: Multi-page extraction with deduplication
evals.prompt: Extract 3 pages of ads from https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise. Use list-view-only mode for speed.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with ads from 3 pages of results. Verify that duplicate ads (same ad appearing across scroll loads) are properly deduplicated - each ad ID should appear only once.

evals.name: Full extraction with detail pages
evals.prompt: I want to analyze Wise's advertising on LinkedIn. Extract 2 pages of ads from https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise including all detail page information (destination URLs, targeting, impressions).
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with ad data from 2 pages showing complete ad campaigns including targeting info, impressions, destination URLs, and all other detail page fields.

evals.name: Specific fields extraction
evals.prompt: Go to https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise and extract the following for each ad: advertiser name, ad headline, destination URL, and targeting parameters. Get 2 pages of results with detail pages.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with the specified fields extracted from ads across 2 pages of results, including destination URLs and targeting parameters from detail pages.

evals.name: Rapid list-view benchmark
evals.prompt: Benchmark the list-view-only extraction speed. Extract 5 pages of ads from https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise without visiting any detail pages. Report the time taken.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with ads from 5 pages. Should complete in approximately 25-50 seconds (5-10 seconds per page). Report should include timing information.
